image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a salad featuring sliced cucumbers and diced red peppers (or tomatoes) on a white plate. The cucumbers are cut into rounds and half-moons, revealing the inner flesh and seed structure. Some slices retain the dark green skin, while others show the pale interior. The vegetables appear glossy, likely dressed with oil or vinegar, and there are visible granular textures suggesting salt or sugar seasoning.
